**AN AVERAGING PROCESS FOR UNIPOTENT GROUP ACTIONS AMNON YEKUTIELI**

11 pp, 3 sections.

**Abstract.** W e present an averaging process for sections of a torsor unde r a unipotent group. This process allows one to integrate local sections of such a torsor into a global simplicial section. The results of this paper have applica- tions to deformation quantization of algebraic varieties. 0. Introduction Let K be a ﬁeld of characteristic 0. Our main result is the following theorem. Theorem 0.1. Let G be a unipotent algebraic group over K, let X be a K-scheme, let Z be a G-torsor over X, and let Y be any X-scheme.
